steps.thought: List all available tests on the station to understand what diagnostic tools can be used.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check all communication buses and devices for initial faults.
steps.observation: The power-on selftest failed because the I2C device 'imu' was not found on the bus, while camera, compass, and CAN nodes enumerated correctly.

hypotheses.rationale: The IMU is missing from the I2C bus during power-on enumeration, pointing to a disconnected or poorly seated I2C harness connector.
An internal hardware failure on the IMU board could prevent it from responding on the I2C bus.

steps.thought: I will run the harness continuity test to check the wiring and bus resistance of the I2C bus where the IMU was not found.
steps.observation: The harness continuity test confirms intermittent I2C continuity with a high resistance of 8.816 ohms, while power-on self-test failed to find the I2C IMU device. This strongly points to a loose or damaged I2C connector rather than an internal IMU sensor failure.

hypotheses.rationale: High resistance and intermittent continuity on the I2C bus combined with a missing IMU device directly indicate a loose I2C connector.
An internal sensor fault is still remotely possible if the communication failure stems from the IMU board itself rather than the connector.

steps.thought: The I2C connector is loose, causing the IMU not to be found and intermittent I2C continuity. I will propose the rework to reseat the I2C connector.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
